text: The subtle nature is not attainable by those who do not practice austerity; this is the state of equilibrium among sattva, rajas, and tamas. This is intellect, this is ego. These are the five subtle elements, the eleven sense organs, and the five great elements. This is the Self (Purusha), distinct from all of these. This is what is to be understood. For one whose intellect has not been purified, liberation is not possible.
